Maria: quick perf dump for reranker+embed sweep across regions and hw. posting raw notes before i formalize the dashboard link.

Samir: awesome. config?

Maria: short: model=rwd-rerank-1, dims=768/1024/1536, quant=fp16 on GPU, int8 on CPU (post-train symmetric and per-channel test), GPUs=A100(40G)/H100(80G)/T4(16G), CPU=perf-metal-16 (16 cores), regions=us-west-2,eu-central-1,ap-northeast-1. batches: embed 1/8/32/128, rerank 1/4/16.

Oliver: are metrics per-stage? latency P50/P95?

Maria: yes. embeds/s and rerank qps, P50/P95 per call, memory, kernel chosen. runtime had continuous batching ON for these numbers (20ms max wait).

perf-bot: perf-run 1766234567 started by Maria — collecting logs s3://perf-redwood/bench/1766234567

Maria: sample CSV rows (region,hw,dim,batch,embeds_per_s,rerank_qps,p50_ms,p95_ms):
"us-west-2,A100,768,32,52000,4200,6,24"
"us-west-2,H100,768,32,61000,4900,5,18"
"eu-central-1,T4,768,32,21000,1800,12,48"
"ap-northeast-1,CPU-16core,768,32,2400,200,85,210"
"us-west-2,A100,1536,8,15000,1200,9,36"
"us-west-2,H100,1536,8,17500,1400,7,28"
"eu-central-1,T4,1536,8,6200,540,20,80"
"ap-northeast-1,CPU-16core,1536,8,800,60,180,420"

Samir: H100 ~15-20% faster than A100 at 768/32 for embeds; matches higher mem bw and newer Triton kernels.

Dave: T4 still decent for 768 small-batch; poor at 1536 as expected. good candidate for low-cost fleets.

Oliver: rerank implementation details? CPU path?

Maria: rerank = batched matmul + tiny MLP. CPU uses int8 path (MKL GEMM + dequant). accuracy hit ~0.3% AUC for symmetric int8; per-channel reduces that but costs perf.

Eva: which kernels selected? flash-attn / cuBLAS / Triton?

Maria: runtime auto-selects: H100 prefers Triton fused kernels + flash-attn for dim>=1024; A100 uses cuBLAS mostly + some Triton microkernels; T4 falls back to cuBLAS (our build lacks new Triton for T4).

Samir: did you capture SM-util and TFLOPs?

Maria: sample from H100 768x32 run: SM_util=72%, mem_bw_eff=68%, achieved_tflops=22.4, kernel=triton_fused_gemm_768x32.

Dave: eu-central T4 slower vs us-west: driver mismatch?

Maria: yes - eu T4 nodes use CUDA 11.4 vs 11.8 in us-west, accounting for ~10-15% loss. I'll add driver column to dashboard.

Oliver: capacity sizing example: want 10k embeds/s and 1k rerank qps.

Maria: guidance: A100 ~52k embeds/s@768/32 -> reserve 60% -> 31k usable. so 1 A100 for 10k embed target. For rerank at dim1536: H100 ~1.2k qps per GPU -> 1 H100 meets 1k qps; A100 needs 2.

Eva: int8 quality regressions?

Maria: symmetric int8 = -0.28% AUC, -0.005 MRR on 10k eval pairs. per-channel quant reduces to -0.12% AUC but ~10% perf drop on CPU.

perf-bot: perf-run 1766234567 completed — summary: https://redwood.internal/perf/1766234567/summary.pdf

Maria: TODOs: add driver version to dashboard, add cost-per-embed table across hw+region (include spot pricing), add per-channel quant baseline to docs, upload raw CSV. csv at s3://perf-redwood/bench/1766234567/sweep.csv

Samir: for tight latency SLO (<10ms P95) what's feasible?

Maria: only H100/A100 for dim<=1024 with batch=1 or continuous batching with <=5ms wait. T4/CPU can't meet P95<10ms except maybe trivial 768 batch1 embed.

Dave: capturing this for product infra; we should expose recommended region+hw in self-serve pricing.

Maria: will PR a short table + csv link. ping me for specific numbers.

Samir: :thumbsup:

Maria: closing: biggest perf wins = H100 + Triton fused kernels + continuous batching. ops-cost tradeoff = CPU int8 cheap but accuracy hit, T4 spot fleet = mid perf/low cost.
